eg: Poorer countries often lack the resources to recover quickly from a major natural disaster.
egCn: 较贫穷的国家往往缺乏从重大自然灾害中迅速恢复的资源。
collocations: be hit by a natural disaster

eg: Rising sea levels could force millions of people in coastal cities to leave their homes.
egCn: 海平面上升可能迫使沿海城市的数百万人离开家园。

eg: Supermarkets should cut down on plastic packaging, especially for fresh fruit and vegetables.
egCn: 超市应减少塑料包装，尤其是新鲜水果和蔬菜的包装。

eg: Trees absorb carbon dioxide, which is why planting forests can help slow climate change.
egCn: 树木吸收二氧化碳，这就是植树造林有助于减缓气候变化的原因。

eg: The wetland was turned into a nature reserve to protect rare birds and plants.
egCn: 这片湿地被改建为自然保护区，以保护珍稀鸟类和植物。

eg: The ban on certain chemicals has allowed the ozone layer to recover slowly.
egCn: 对某些化学品的禁令使臭氧层得以缓慢恢复。
collocations: a hole in the ozone layer

eg: Acid rain caused by factory emissions has damaged forests and lakes across the region.
egCn: 工厂排放导致的酸雨破坏了该地区的森林和湖泊。

eg: Some residents oppose the new wind farm because they think it will spoil the view.
egCn: 一些居民反对新建风力发电场，因为他们认为它会破坏景观。

cn: 环保人士；环境保护主义者
eg: Environmentalists warn that the new airport will destroy an important wildlife habitat.
egCn: 环保人士警告说，新机场将摧毁一个重要的野生动物栖息地。

eg: On days with heavy smog, schools keep children indoors to protect their lungs.
egCn: 在雾霾严重的日子里，学校会让孩子们待在室内以保护他们的肺。

eg: Many households do not know how to dispose of old batteries safely.
egCn: 许多家庭不知道如何安全地处理废旧电池。

eg: Switching to clean energy will create new jobs as well as reduce pollution.
egCn: 转向清洁能源不仅能减少污染，还能创造新的就业机会。

eg: Hotter summers are causing serious water shortages in parts of southern Europe.
egCn: 更炎热的夏季正在南欧部分地区造成严重的缺水问题。

eg: As the polar ice caps melt, global sea levels will continue to rise.
egCn: 随着极地冰盖融化，全球海平面将继续上升。
collocations: the melting of the ice caps

eg: Governments could offer grants to families who install solar panels on their roofs.
egCn: 政府可以向在屋顶安装太阳能电池板的家庭发放补助。

eg: If we keep using natural resources at this rate, future generations will suffer.
egCn: 如果我们继续以这种速度消耗自然资源，子孙后代将深受其害。

eg: Biodegradable packaging breaks down naturally instead of staying in landfill for centuries.
egCn: 可生物降解的包装能自然分解，而不会在垃圾填埋场里存留几个世纪。

eg: Overfishing has pushed several species of fish close to extinction.
egCn: 过度捕捞已使多种鱼类濒临灭绝。

eg: The company aims to become carbon neutral by planting trees and using renewable power.
egCn: 该公司计划通过植树和使用可再生能源实现碳中和。

eg: Car exhaust releases harmful pollutants that can trigger asthma in young children.
egCn: 汽车尾气释放的有害污染物可能诱发幼儿哮喘。

eg: Building a dam across the river could cause serious ecological damage.
egCn: 在这条河上修建水坝可能造成严重的生态破坏。

eg: Cutting down trees on hillsides often leads to soil erosion and landslides.
egCn: 砍伐山坡上的树木往往会导致水土流失和山体滑坡。

eg: Large-scale reforestation projects can restore damaged land and absorb carbon.
egCn: 大规模的重新造林项目可以修复受损土地并吸收碳。

eg: A carbon tax would make polluting industries pay for the damage they cause.
egCn: 征收碳税将使污染行业为其造成的破坏买单。

eg: Overgrazing and drought have accelerated desertification in many dry regions of the world.
egCn: 过度放牧和干旱加速了世界上许多干旱地区的荒漠化。

eg: Online banking saves time, but older people often find it confusing at first.
egCn: 网上银行节省时间，但老年人一开始往往觉得它令人困惑。

eg: You should update your apps regularly to protect your phone from security risks.
egCn: 你应该定期更新应用程序，以保护手机免受安全风险。

eg: Thanks to video calls, I can see my grandparents every week even though they live abroad.
egCn: 多亏了视频通话，即使祖父母住在国外，我每周也能见到他们。

eg: The school's computer network crashed on the morning of the exam.
egCn: 考试当天早上，学校的计算机网络崩溃了。

eg: Some parents worry that violent video games make children more aggressive.
egCn: 一些家长担心暴力电子游戏会让孩子更具攻击性。

eg: Modern home appliances such as dishwashers have given families more free time.
egCn: 洗碗机等现代家用电器让家庭拥有了更多空闲时间。

eg: Labour-saving devices have dramatically reduced the time people spend on housework.
egCn: 省力的设备大大减少了人们做家务的时间。

eg: Interactive whiteboards make lessons more engaging for students of all ages.
egCn: 交互式白板让各个年龄段学生的课堂都更具吸引力。

eg: Even very young children quickly learn how to use a touchscreen.
egCn: 即使是很小的孩子也能很快学会使用触摸屏。

eg: Schools in poorer areas cannot afford to replace outdated computer hardware.
egCn: 贫困地区的学校无力更换过时的计算机硬件。

eg: Skilled programmers are in high demand, so many students now study coding.
egCn: 技术娴熟的程序员需求量很大，因此如今许多学生都在学编程。

eg: Opening attachments from unknown senders can infect your laptop with a computer virus.
egCn: 打开陌生发件人的附件可能会让你的笔记本电脑感染计算机病毒。
collocations: be infected by a computer virus

eg: Without high-speed internet, rural businesses struggle to compete with companies in cities.
egCn: 没有高速网络，农村企业很难与城市里的公司竞争。

eg: Millions of people in remote villages still have no reliable internet access.
egCn: 偏远村庄里仍有数百万人无法稳定地上网。

eg: Tech companies must explain clearly how they collect and use our personal data.
egCn: 科技公司必须清楚说明它们如何收集和使用我们的个人数据。

eg: As we move towards a cashless society, older people may be left behind.
egCn: 随着我们迈向无现金社会，老年人可能会被落下。

eg: Many small businesses now sell their products through online platforms.
egCn: 如今许多小企业通过网络平台销售产品。

eg: Automation is likely to replace many routine jobs in factories and offices.
egCn: 自动化很可能会取代工厂和办公室里的许多常规性工作。

eg: Doctors are using machine learning to spot diseases earlier in medical scans.
egCn: 医生正在利用机器学习在医学影像中更早地发现疾病。

eg: Advances in robotics mean that machines can now perform delicate surgery.
egCn: 机器人技术的进步意味着机器如今能够进行精细的手术。

cn: 数字原住民（从小接触数字技术的一代人）
eg: Today's teenagers are digital natives who have never known a world without the internet.
egCn: 如今的青少年是数字原住民，他们从未经历过没有互联网的世界。

eg: The rapid growth of e-commerce has forced many high-street shops to close.
egCn: 电子商务的迅速发展迫使许多商业街店铺关门。

eg: Much of the world's e-waste ends up in developing countries, where it is burnt unsafely.
egCn: 世界上大部分电子垃圾最终流入发展中国家，在那里被不安全地焚烧。

eg: Some argue that tech giants have too much influence over what we see online.
egCn: 一些人认为，科技巨头对我们在网上看到的内容影响过大。

eg: An over-reliance on calculators may weaken students' basic maths skills.
egCn: 过度依赖计算器可能会削弱学生的基本数学能力。

eg: A balanced diet with plenty of vegetables is the best way to stay healthy.
egCn: 富含蔬菜的均衡饮食是保持健康的最佳方式。

eg: Warming up before exercise reduces the risk of serious injury.
egCn: 运动前热身可以降低严重受伤的风险。

eg: It took my father three months to fully recover from the operation.
egCn: 我父亲花了三个月才从手术中完全康复。

eg: Many fizzy drinks contain a surprising number of calories but almost no nutrients.
egCn: 许多碳酸饮料含有惊人的热量，却几乎没有营养。

eg: Restaurants should clearly label dishes for customers with a food allergy.
egCn: 餐馆应为有食物过敏的顾客清楚标注菜品。

eg: Many older patients take several types of medication every day.
egCn: 许多老年患者每天要服用好几种药物。

eg: Spending too much time alone online can increase the risk of depression among teenagers.
egCn: 独自上网时间过长可能会增加青少年患抑郁症的风险。

eg: Banning smoking in restaurants was a major step forward for public health.
egCn: 在餐馆禁烟是公共卫生领域的一大进步。

eg: Every secondary school pupil should learn basic first aid in case of emergencies.
egCn: 每个中学生都应该学习基本的急救知识，以备不时之需。

eg: Public buildings must be accessible to people with a physical disability.
egCn: 公共建筑必须方便肢体残疾人士进出。

eg: Some young models are dangerously underweight, which sets a poor example for teenagers.
egCn: 一些年轻模特体重过轻到了危险的程度，给青少年树立了不良榜样。

eg: Eating too much salt can lead to high blood pressure and heart disease.
egCn: 吃太多盐会导致高血压和心脏病。

eg: Beans and lentils are a cheap source of protein for people who do not eat meat.
egCn: 对不吃肉的人来说，豆类和小扁豆是廉价的蛋白质来源。

eg: In some countries, people without health insurance cannot afford basic medical care.
egCn: 在一些国家，没有医疗保险的人负担不起基本的医疗服务。

cn: （疾病或战争的）爆发；突然发生
eg: Health officials acted quickly to control the outbreak before it spread to other cities.
egCn: 卫生官员迅速采取行动，在疫情蔓延到其他城市之前控制住了它。

eg: Adults are advised to do at least 150 minutes of physical activity each week.
egCn: 建议成年人每周至少进行 150 分钟的体育活动。

cn: 大流行病；（全国或全球性）流行病
eg: The pandemic showed how quickly a virus can spread in a connected world.
egCn: 这场大流行病表明，在一个互联互通的世界里，病毒传播得有多快。

eg: Vaccination programmes have greatly reduced deaths from infectious diseases in children.
egCn: 疫苗接种计划大大减少了儿童因传染病死亡的人数。

eg: Malnutrition remains a leading cause of illness among children in the poorest regions.
egCn: 营养不良仍然是最贫困地区儿童患病的主要原因之一。

eg: Fresh fruit contains essential nutrients that processed snacks simply cannot provide.
egCn: 新鲜水果含有加工零食根本无法提供的必需营养素。

eg: As people live longer, the number of patients with dementia is expected to rise.
egCn: 随着人们寿命延长，痴呆症患者的数量预计将会上升。

eg: Pressure to look thin can contribute to eating disorders among young women.
egCn: 追求苗条的压力可能导致年轻女性出现饮食失调。

eg: Spending more on preventive care could save the health service money in the long run.
egCn: 在预防性医疗上加大投入，从长远看可以为医疗系统省钱。

eg: Long-term sleep deprivation affects memory, mood and the ability to concentrate.
egCn: 长期睡眠不足会影响记忆力、情绪和注意力。

eg: Pharmaceutical companies spend billions developing new drugs, which keeps prices high.
egCn: 制药公司花费数十亿开发新药，这使得药价居高不下。

eg: Banning cars from the city centre would make it safer and more pleasant for shoppers.
egCn: 禁止汽车驶入市中心会让购物者感到更安全、更舒适。

eg: Local residents complained that the new nightclub was too noisy.
egCn: 当地居民抱怨新开的夜总会太吵。

eg: The old factory was knocked down and replaced by a modern block of flats.
egCn: 那座旧工厂被拆除，取而代之的是一栋现代化公寓楼。
collocations: live in a block of flats

eg: Young people are attracted to big cities by better jobs and a lively nightlife.
egCn: 更好的工作和丰富的夜生活吸引年轻人来到大城市。

eg: Finding a parking space in the city centre can take longer than the journey itself.
egCn: 在市中心找停车位花的时间可能比路程本身还长。

eg: Rising property prices have made it impossible for many young couples to buy a home.
egCn: 不断上涨的房价使许多年轻夫妇无法买房。

eg: Homeowners can receive government grants to make their houses more energy-efficient.
egCn: 房主可以获得政府补助，让住房更加节能。

eg: Tenants need stronger legal protection against sudden increases in rent.
egCn: 租户需要更有力的法律保护，以免房租突然上涨。

eg: Young couples often spend decades paying off their mortgage.
egCn: 年轻夫妇往往要花几十年时间还清房贷。

eg: Lower speed limits near schools would greatly improve road safety for children.
egCn: 降低学校附近的限速将大大改善儿童的道路安全。

eg: Well-designed public spaces encourage neighbours to meet and talk to each other.
egCn: 精心设计的公共空间能促使邻里见面交流。

cn: 汽车拥有量；私家车保有
eg: Car ownership has risen sharply as incomes in developing countries have grown.
egCn: 随着发展中国家收入增长，汽车拥有量急剧上升。

eg: Drivers who break the speed limit near schools should face heavier fines.
egCn: 在学校附近超速的司机应受到更重的罚款。

eg: Building more affordable homes is the only real solution to the housing shortage.
egCn: 建造更多经济适用房是解决住房短缺的唯一切实办法。

eg: Because of light pollution, most city children have never seen a sky full of stars.
egCn: 由于光污染，大多数城市孩子从未见过满天繁星。

eg: Low-income families are often forced to live far from where they work.
egCn: 低收入家庭常常被迫住在离工作地点很远的地方。

eg: Within fifty years, the small fishing village grew into a busy metropolis.
egCn: 五十年间，这个小渔村发展成了一座繁忙的大都市。

eg: The regeneration of the old docks has brought new jobs and visitors to the area.
egCn: 旧码头的更新改造为该地区带来了新的就业机会和游客。

eg: Most city dwellers rarely have the chance to experience real peace and quiet.
egCn: 大多数都市人很少有机会体验真正的宁静。

eg: Derelict factories could be converted into affordable housing or community centres.
egCn: 废弃的工厂可以改建成经济适用房或社区中心。

eg: The council plans to build more social housing for families on low incomes.
egCn: 市政府计划为低收入家庭建造更多保障性住房。

eg: Since the congestion charge was introduced, traffic in the centre has fallen noticeably.
egCn: 自从开征拥堵费以来，市中心的交通流量明显下降。

eg: I grew up in a quiet village, so the bustling streets of London amazed me.
egCn: 我在一个安静的村庄长大，所以伦敦熙熙攘攘的街道让我惊叹不已。

eg: The two cities have gradually merged into one huge conurbation of over ten million people.
egCn: 这两座城市逐渐合并成一个人口超过一千万的巨大都市区。

eg: When factories closed, the area fell into urban decay, with empty shops and rising crime.
egCn: 工厂倒闭后，该地区陷入城市衰败，商店空置，犯罪率上升。

eg: International charities provide clean water and medical care in many developing countries.
egCn: 国际慈善机构在许多发展中国家提供清洁饮用水和医疗服务。

eg: More and more young people choose to work overseas for a few years after graduating.
egCn: 越来越多的年轻人选择在毕业后去海外工作几年。

eg: The old castle has become the town's most popular tourist attraction.
egCn: 这座古城堡已成为该镇最受欢迎的旅游景点。

eg: Large companies often move factories abroad simply to increase their profits.
egCn: 大公司常常仅仅为了增加利润而把工厂迁往国外。

eg: As English spreads, fewer children grow up speaking their native language at home.
egCn: 随着英语的普及，在家说母语长大的孩子越来越少。

eg: A weak currency makes a country's exports cheaper and attracts more tourists.
egCn: 本币疲软会使一个国家的出口商品更便宜，并吸引更多游客。

eg: Migration from rural areas to cities has transformed the country's economy.
egCn: 从农村到城市的人口迁移改变了该国的经济。

eg: Thanks to the internet, even small family firms can now sell to the global market.
egCn: 多亏了互联网，如今就连家族小企业也能把产品卖向全球市场。

eg: Buying fair trade coffee helps ensure that farmers receive a decent price.
egCn: 购买公平贸易咖啡有助于确保农民获得合理的价格。

eg: Critics argue that foreign aid does not always reach the people who need it most.
egCn: 批评者认为，外援并不总能送到最需要的人手中。

eg: Many poorer nations spend more on paying off debt than on education.
egCn: 许多较贫穷的国家在偿还债务上的花费超过教育支出。

eg: During the recession, thousands of small businesses were forced to close.
egCn: 经济衰退期间，数千家小企业被迫倒闭。

eg: Low-cost flights have made international travel possible for ordinary families.
egCn: 廉价航班让普通家庭也能出国旅行。

cn: 使用多种语言的；多语的
eg: Multilingual employees are highly valued by companies that trade internationally.
egCn: 从事国际贸易的公司非常看重会多种语言的员工。

eg: China has become the largest trading partner of many African countries.
egCn: 中国已成为许多非洲国家最大的贸易伙伴。

eg: Problems such as climate change cannot be solved without international cooperation.
egCn: 没有国际合作，气候变化之类的问题就无法解决。

eg: Globalisation has created jobs in some regions while destroying them in others.
egCn: 全球化在一些地区创造了就业岗位，同时也在另一些地区让岗位消失。

eg: Some people blame consumerism for encouraging us to buy things we do not need.
egCn: 一些人指责消费主义怂恿我们购买自己并不需要的东西。

eg: Older generations often see the westernisation of food and fashion as a threat to tradition.
egCn: 老一辈人常把饮食和时尚的西化视为对传统的威胁。

eg: Studying abroad develops cross-cultural skills that employers increasingly value.
egCn: 出国留学能培养雇主日益看重的跨文化能力。

eg: Economic migrants often send part of their wages home to support their families.
egCn: 经济移民常常把部分工资寄回家养家。

eg: Well-managed ecotourism can fund conservation while providing jobs for local people.
egCn: 管理得当的生态旅游既能为环保提供资金，又能为当地人提供工作。

eg: Thanks to the internet, the world has truly become a global village.
egCn: 多亏了互联网，世界真正变成了一个地球村。
collocations: the idea of a global village

eg: Removing trade barriers allows consumers to buy imported goods at lower prices.
egCn: 消除贸易壁垒让消费者能以更低的价格购买进口商品。

eg: Critics fear that global brands are leading to the homogenisation of local cultures.
egCn: 批评者担心全球品牌正在导致地方文化的同质化。

eg: Scientists still know surprisingly little about how the universe began.
egCn: 对于宇宙是如何起源的，科学家们所知仍出奇地少。

eg: Astronauts on the space station carry out experiments that cannot be done on Earth.
egCn: 空间站上的宇航员开展在地球上无法完成的实验。

eg: Researchers at the university have developed a cheaper test for the disease.
egCn: 该大学的研究人员研发出了一种更便宜的该病检测方法。

eg: Scientific progress has allowed people to live longer and healthier lives.
egCn: 科学进步使人们活得更长久、更健康。

eg: In my opinion, the internet is the most important invention of the last hundred years.
egCn: 在我看来，互联网是过去一百年里最重要的发明。

eg: Darwin's theory of evolution changed the way people understood the natural world.
egCn: 达尔文的进化论改变了人们对自然界的认识。

eg: Some illnesses are caused by genetic factors rather than an unhealthy lifestyle.
egCn: 有些疾病是由遗传因素而非不健康的生活方式引起的。

eg: Cancer begins when cells in the body start to grow out of control.
egCn: 当身体里的细胞开始失控生长时，癌症就开始了。

eg: Supporters of nuclear power argue that it produces almost no greenhouse gases.
egCn: 核电的支持者认为，它几乎不产生温室气体。

eg: My interest in astronomy began when my father bought me a small telescope.
egCn: 我对天文学的兴趣始于父亲给我买了一架小型望远镜。

eg: Whales and dolphins are mammals, so they must come to the surface to breathe.
egCn: 鲸和海豚是哺乳动物，所以它们必须浮出水面呼吸。

eg: Animal rights groups argue that testing cosmetics on animals should be banned worldwide.
egCn: 动物权利组织认为，应在全球范围内禁止用动物测试化妆品。

eg: The researchers took blood samples from over two thousand volunteers.
egCn: 研究人员从两千多名志愿者身上采集了血样。

egCn: 太空旅游目前仍然太贵，只有非常富有的人才负担得起。

eg: Students need practical experience in the lab as well as theoretical knowledge.
egCn: 学生除了理论知识，还需要在实验室里积累实践经验。

egCn: 单个突变就可能让病毒更容易在人与人之间传播。

egCn: 通过自然选择，更能适应环境的动物得以生存。

egCn: 干细胞研究为目前无法治愈的疾病患者带来了希望。
